definitions.explanation: Avant-garde painter and sculptor (1911–1996), creator of the Tower of the Sun built for the 1970 Osaka Expo.

examples.japanese: {岡本太郎|おかもとたろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to see Okamoto Tarō's works.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{太陽|たいよう}の{塔|とう}→太陽の塔：33330_taiyounotou⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{岡本太郎|おかもとたろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The Tower of the Sun was made by Okamoto Tarō.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧だ」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{岡本太郎|おかもとたろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Okamoto Tarō's words "Art is an explosion!" are still well known today.

notes:
The Tower of the Sun still stands in Expo '70 Commemorative Park in Suita, Osaka, and his catchphrase made him a familiar television figure.

- ⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧だ: "Art is an explosion!" (his catchphrase, often quoted or parodied)
